passages.title: C60 — Ruy Lopez
passages.text: Ruy Lopez: Bb5 pressures the knight defending e5, and the game turns on the centre and White's queenside pawn advance. Ruy Lopez is classified as ECO C60. A representative move sequence is 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5.
